title: gRNA Design and Cloning into Loop L2 Plasmids
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5jqg4mw
materials: Oligo annealing Mix oligos with water as follow: oligo F (100μM) 1μl oligo R (100μM) 1μl water 8μl Total volume 10μl Anneal in a thermocycler using the following parameters: 37 o C for 30 min, 95 o C for 5 min and then ramp down to 25 o C at 5 o C per min. After annealing the gRNA can be directly cloned into L2_gRNA-CAs9-CsA or L2_gRNA-CsA plasmids without the need of any further processing.

Cloning into backbone vector In a 0.2 mL tube set up the following reaction: Place samples on the thermocycler and incubated using the following program: Assembly: 15 cycles: 3 minutes at 37 o C and 4 minutes at 16 o C Termination: 5 minutes at 50 o C and 10 minutes at 80 o C Transform chemically competent using 1 μL of reaction and plate on LB agar plates with 100 μg/mL spec and X-gal 40. Incubate at 37 oC for 16 h. Confirm with sequencing

steps.title: Design and order gRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Create forward and reverse oligos that contain the 20‑nt guide sequence flanked by the required ligation overhangs and order them as standard desalted oligos for cloning into L2_gRNA‑CAs9‑CsA or L2_gRNA‑CsA plasmids.

substeps.instruction: Determine the 20‑nt guide sequence (represented as NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN).
Add the 5' overhang "TCG" to the forward oligo and the 3' overhang "gt" (resulting in 5’-TCG‑NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN‑gt‑3’).
Add the 5' overhang "AAAac" to the reverse oligo (resulting in 5’-AAAac‑NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN‑3’).
Order both oligos as standard desalted oligos.
Use the ordered oligos for ligation into either the L2_gRNA‑CAs9‑CsA or L2_gRNA‑CsA plasmid.
